trust_boundaries: External to Ingestion (kinesis_producer, pubsub_connector, sftp_ingest, api_webhook to kafka_cluster/kafka_connect)
Ingestion to Processing (kafka_cluster to flink_cluster, spark_batch)
Storage to Serving (data_lake_curated to feature_store, data_warehouse to bi_dashboard)
Platform to All (iam_service, airflow_orchestrator, data_catalog to various components)
architecture_summary.operational_context: Hybrid multi-cloud data pipeline with streaming and batch processing, ML serving, and BI analytics

threat_actors.name: External Opportunistic Attacker
threat_actors.motivation: Financial gain through data exfiltration or ransomware
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Exploiting unpatched vulnerabilities in external ingress components (SFTP, API Webhook) or misconfigured Kafka Connect
non_capabilities: No physical access to data centers
No pre-existing insider knowledge of internal network topology
Cannot bypass MFA on IAM service

threat_actors.name: Insider Threat
threat_actors.motivation: Data theft for competitive advantage or sabotage
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Using valid credentials to access Data Warehouse or Feature Store via BI Dashboard or direct API
non_capabilities: Cannot modify IAM service configuration without admin privileges
Cannot access external data sources directly
Limited to data accessible via their role-based permissions

threat_actors.name: Adversarial ML Agent
threat_actors.motivation: Model poisoning or data manipulation to degrade ML serving accuracy
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Injecting adversarial data into Feature Store or ML Model Registry via compromised upstream data sources
non_capabilities: Cannot directly access ML Serving Endpoint inference logic
No ability to retrain models without access to training pipeline
Cannot modify model registry metadata without write permissions

attack_paths.impact: Attacker gains initial access to the ingestion tier by exploiting a vulnerability in the API Webhook Receiver, potentially leading to data injection or lateral movement to Kafka Cluster
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: API Webhook Receivers are commonly exposed to the internet and frequently targeted by opportunistic attackers

attack_paths.impact: Attacker uses stolen or compromised credentials to access IAM Service, enabling lateral movement to Kafka Cluster, Data Lake, and Data Warehouse
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Credential theft is a common initial access vector, but MFA and password policies reduce likelihood

attack_paths.impact: Attacker uses compromised credentials or tokens to access Kafka Cluster, enabling data exfiltration or injection of malicious data into the pipeline
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Kafka Cluster is a central component with high-value data, making it a prime target for lateral movement

attack_paths.impact: Attacker exfiltrates sensitive data from the Data Lake - Raw Zone via web services, leading to data breach
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Data Lake - Raw Zone contains unprocessed data that may include sensitive information, and exfiltration via web services is a common technique

attack_paths.impact: Attacker injects adversarial data into the Feature Store, degrading the accuracy of ML models served by the ML Serving Endpoint
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Adversarial data injection requires sophisticated knowledge of the ML pipeline and is less common than traditional data exfiltration

attack_paths.impact: Attacker encrypts data in the Data Warehouse, causing denial of service and potential data loss
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Ransomware attacks on data warehouses are less common but possible if the attacker gains sufficient access

attack_paths.impact: Attacker executes malicious scripts via the Airflow Orchestrator, enabling lateral movement to Spark Batch Processor and Flink Streaming Cluster
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Airflow Orchestrator is a central component with high privileges, making it a prime target for execution of malicious scripts

attack_paths.impact: Attacker brute-forces credentials to access the SFTP Ingest Gateway, enabling data injection or exfiltration
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: SFTP Ingest Gateways are commonly targeted by brute-force attacks, especially if password policies are weak

findings.severity_rationale: Exploitation of API Webhook Receiver could lead to initial access and lateral movement, with high impact on data integrity and confidentiality
Compromised IAM Service credentials could enable lateral movement to multiple components, but MFA and password policies reduce likelihood
Access to Kafka Cluster could enable data exfiltration or injection of malicious data, with high impact on data integrity and confidentiality
Exfiltration of data from Data Lake - Raw Zone could lead to data breach, with high impact on confidentiality
Adversarial data injection into Feature Store could degrade ML model accuracy, but requires sophisticated knowledge and is less common
Ransomware attack on Data Warehouse could cause denial of service and data loss, but is less common than other attacks
Execution of malicious scripts via Airflow Orchestrator could enable lateral movement to multiple components, with high impact on data integrity and confidentiality
Brute-force attack on SFTP Ingest Gateway could enable data injection or exfiltration, but password policies reduce likelihood

agentic.blast_radius: Data integrity and ML model accuracy
